## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] `npm run e2e` passes (if behaviour or styling changed)
- [ ] `npm run verify:package` passes (if the public API or packaging changed)
- [ ] Tests are added or updated for the change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `## [Unreleased]`
- [ ] The README is updated if the public API or configuration changed
- [ ] Breaking changes are called out above, with migration notes in the changelog
